verdict.rationale: Braintrust's API reference covers the platform programmatically and is backed by a published OpenAPI 3.1.1 spec. It is Mintlify-hosted, with a "Try it" playground container on each endpoint page, but that evidence comes from inspecting served HTML: the runner mounts client-side and no hands-on run is documented. Probes of common OpenAPI paths on the main site returned 404, and per-endpoint code samples are not explicitly shown. Missing for 10: hands-on confirmation that the Try-it runner executes live requests, explicit per-endpoint runnable code samples in multiple languages, independent corroboration of the interactive reference's quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Mintlify-hosted API reference carries a "Try it" playground on each endpoint page
The API is defined by an OpenAPI 3.1.1 specification published at braintrust-openapi on GitHub.
The Braintrust API allows you to interact with all aspects of the Braintrust platform programmatically.
